verdict.rationale: Vendor docs claim cloud agents can build, test, and demo features end-to-end for review and can run in parallel fleets or on schedules (cursor-docs-8, cursor-docs-9, cursor-docs-12), but this is all vendor marketing copy with no independent or hands-on validation in the evidence pack. Community evidence is unrelated to this specific capability and focuses on bugs, pricing, and support issues, leaving the core claim unverified.
